Thank you again for taking such good care of my dog ​​Stanley for the past 5 years.

Each time, I find my dog ​​looking radiant thanks to Véronique's expert care and the attention her team gives to my timid dog. Thank you.

It's already been a year since we started regularly visiting "the den of canine beauty." How time flies!... Véronique Hachim was, I must mention, highly recommended by my friend Jutta Millas, who has been bringing her dog for over 10 years.

In fact, we're friends and practically neighbors; we go together about every three weeks, and our dogs are always happy to meet up and enjoy this pampering session at the "Sea Sun'And Dog" salon.
Autumn is here, but it's still warm, and Véronique, a true professional, knew how to adapt the cuts for our two four-legged friends. They just left looking as elegant and very happy as ever, having received compliments and admiration.

Claudia Amodéo, Journalist
This is the second time that Ava, my 21-month-old cocker spaniel, has been groomed by Mrs. HACHIN: my instructions are followed and I am satisfied.
He's 4 years old today. L'Équipe managed to make him look even more handsome. The flashes were popping...

I am happy to entrust my Toy Poodle to Véronique; I appreciate her expertise, thoroughness, honesty, and sound advice. It's always a pleasure to leave my dog ​​with her; he's in good hands.

First time here: excellent advice, perfect grooming 💯👍...my American Cocker Spaniel came out looking stunning...I'm thrilled with this first experience and of course, I've booked my next appointment for next month...finally, a place where they know their stuff and where they practice the art of grooming on a not-so-easy breed...a huge thank you to you and your team ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I am absolutely delighted with my little Spitz's grooming! The groomer is lovely, very kind, welcoming, and above all, very professional. She took great care of him, and the result is magnificent 😍🐶. His coat is superb, well-maintained, and the cut is truly perfect.
You can immediately tell that she loves animals and that she does her job with passion and gentleness. My Spitz was in very good hands. I completely understand her excellent reputation!
I wholeheartedly recommend this groomer and will definitely be back. Thank you again for your kindness and excellent work! ❤️🐾
Excellent service from professionals, meticulous work, beautiful dog, happy owners
As always, when Pharaoh passes through Véronique's hands, he's transformed: a fantastic cut as usual. What magnificent work, well done Véronique, you're a champion!
